sequence.label: Snow-night first meeting
sequence.summary: Source states Shiki and Kokutou Mikiya first meet on a snowy night and later become acquainted after entering high school.

sequence.label: Mifune serial murders and Shiki's self-suspicion
sequence.summary: Source states serial killings occur in Mifune; Shiki appears near scenes and suspects herself or SHIKI, eventually trying and failing to kill Mikiya.

sequence.label: Accident and SHIKI's disappearance
sequence.summary: Source states SHIKI/织 accepts disappearance and dies/disappears in a traffic accident in Shiki's place; Shiki enters a two-year coma.

sequence.label: Awakening and Mystic Eyes
sequence.summary: Source states Shiki wakes from coma, awakens Mystic Eyes of Death Perception, initially attempts to destroy her eyes, and is guided by Aozaki Touko into accepting her condition and Garan no Dou work.

sequence.label: Pain Remaining / Asagami Fujino confrontation
sequence.summary: Source states Shiki confronts Fujino, loses or has her left arm disabled, defeats Fujino, and saves her by killing the appendicitis rather than Fujino herself; Touko later provides a prosthetic.

sequence.label: Overlooking View / Fujou Kirie case
sequence.summary: Source states Shiki investigates schoolgirl jump suicides and severs/kills Fujou Kirie's ghostly body connection at Fujou Building.

sequence.label: Paradox Spiral / Ogawa Apartment
sequence.summary: Source states Shiki shelters Enjou Tomoe, becomes involved in Araya Souren's Ogawa Apartment Root experiment, is captured, then escapes and kills Araya with Kuji Kanesada.

sequence.label: Oblivion Recording / Reien case
sequence.summary: Source states Shiki infiltrates Reien Girls' Academy and exposes the plots involving Kuramitsu? no, Genno Satsuki and Ouji Misaya; because the local source romanization is not validated, names remain Chinese-label source forms only.

sequence.label: Murder Speculation later / Shirazumi Lio
sequence.summary: Source states the old killer reappears as Shirazumi Lio, who tries to force Shiki into becoming like him; Shiki kills Lio and Mikiya survives heavily injured with loss of left eye.

sequence.label: Final snow conversation with Void/root personality
sequence.summary: Source states Mikiya meets the root/Void personality in snow; she speaks with him and announces permanent sleep, leaving the body to Shiki.

sequence.label: Marriage, daughter, family succession notes
sequence.summary: Source states Shiki and Mikiya marry, have daughter Mana, and later Shiki inherits the Ryougi family; exact dating is mixed in the source and preserved as future-gospel notes rather than merged into original 1995-1999 sequence.
